Examples

What this looks like in practice.

Customer Service

After-hours and overflow coverage

A voice agent answers every call — after hours, during jobs, on hold — qualifies the caller, books or transfers, and texts a confirmation.

Works with Retell AI, Vapi, Bland AI, ElevenLabs and more
Sales & CRM

Inbound lead qualification and instant response across every channel

Every inbound lead — web form, GBP message, Facebook, LSA, missed call — gets a personalized text and email within 60 seconds, then a 7-touch follow-up until they book or say no.

Works with Twilio, ServiceTitan, Jobber, Clio and more
Accounting & Finance

AR: dunning sequences by email, SMS and voice

Invoices generated from completed work, delivered with a payment link, and chased with a polite, escalating sequence by email, text, and — for the stubborn — a voice call.

Works with Retell AI, Twilio, Jobber, Housecall Pro and more
Customer Service

FAQ and order-status handling by chat, email, SMS, and voice

A chat/email/SMS agent trained on the client's real knowledge answers the repetitive 60% — order status, hours, pricing, how-to — and hands the rest to a human with context.

Sales & CRM

Outbound appointment setting and confirmation

An agent that calls or texts warm lists — past customers, inbound leads, event contacts — to book appointments, then confirms and reminds.

What the research says

What the research says.

We don't quote our own case numbers on this site. These are independent, published findings on the problems we work on. Your own numbers come from your consultation.

7×

Companies that contact a web lead within an hour are nearly seven times more likely to qualify it than those that wait even one hour longer — and most companies don't respond that fast.

Harvard Business Review, “The Short Life of Online Sales Leads” (study of 2,241 companies) ↗
+14%

Customer-support agents given a generative-AI assistant resolved 14% more issues per hour on average — 34% more for newer staff — with better customer sentiment and lower staff turnover.

Brynjolfsson, Li & Raymond, “Generative AI at Work,” NBER Working Paper 31161 (5,179 agents) ↗
$80B

Gartner predicts conversational AI will reduce contact-center agent labor costs by $80 billion in 2026, with one in ten customer interactions automated.

Gartner press release, August 2022 ↗
More visits kept

Text-message appointment reminders increase attendance compared with no reminders, match phone-call reminders, and cost less per attendance.

Cochrane systematic review, “Mobile phone messaging reminders for attendance at healthcare appointments” (8 trials, 6,615 participants) ↗

How we work

It starts with a conversation, not a contract.

1

Free consultation

30 minutes on the phone about your business — what's slow, what's leaking, what you've tried. No pitch. If we can help, we'll say how; if we can't, we'll say that too.

2

Opportunity audit

Two weeks. We interview you and three staff, map the workflows costing you the most, and rank them by what they cost you today and how hard they are to fix.

3

Pilot with a gate

One automation or agent, three to six weeks, a success metric we agree on up front. It runs in shadow mode before a customer ever hears it. If the number doesn't move, you stop.

4

Managed and reported

Go-live starts a month-to-month retainer: monitoring, tuning, a Monday note you can read in five minutes, and one improvement a month. Everything is in your name.

Let's talk about your business — free, 30 minutes, no pitch.
